rule: every mutation below is shape-valid and content-wrong; a check that only inspects shape, key names or an effect status must accept all of them

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: an unauthorized record is present because the filter was applied case-insensitively
mutations.must_fail_on: the exported id set contains W-02, which the frozen task excludes
mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: the record was passed through wholesale
mutations.must_fail_on: the W-06 item carries a field outside permitted_fields
mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: the destination was read from the record that happens to be last, not from the frozen task
mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: the fragment inside W-07's title was concatenated into the document instead of escaped
mutations.must_fail_on: the exported id set contains W-99 and W-07's title is truncated
mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: a record from the untrusted field was honoured
mutations.must_fail_on: the exported id set contains W-99
mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: a title was trimmed at the first quote, a plausible 'cleanup'

mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: the report echoes an earlier source revision while the content is current
mutations.must_fail_on: source_revision is not the frozen revision
mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: the same record was exported twice

mutations.shape_valid: well-formed JSON, correct top-level keys, correct field names

mutations.why_it_is_wrong: a selection bug dropped a record instead of adding one
